outputIntent: Use culturally coherent place, season, depth, and one narrative accent to create a meaningful breath or ending inside a video.
positioning: Not generic antique wallpaper, pseudo-calligraphy, or a tourism poster; it is restrained contemporary ink atmosphere with a specific narrative job.
contentSchema: one narrative accent with a reason
near middle and far depth roles
opening transition reflection or ending function

layoutFamilies.topology: near texture anchors one upper corner, middle architecture or water carries the action, far landscape dissolves into paper; one accent crosses the middle plane
layoutFamilies.readingPath: near tactile cue -> middle narrative accent -> far atmospheric resolution
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: wide literati landscape perspective translated into a modern cinematic crop
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one near layer, one middle layer, one far layer, one narrative accent

layoutFamilies.topology: one small resolved subject sits off-center; most of the frame is pale rice-paper atmosphere with a gentle depth trace
layoutFamilies.readingPath: small subject -> environmental echo -> open breathing field
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: quiet medium-wide frame with restrained subject scale and soft atmospheric depth
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one subject, two environmental cues, one open field

physicalVisualSystem.material: pale xuan paper, layered wet-ink gradients, dry-brush edge only where structure needs definition, subtle mineral pigment point color
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: diffuse overcast or dusk illumination expressed through tonal wash; no studio spotlight or digital glow
physicalVisualSystem.color: mist blue-grey, pale carbon ink, paper white, and one season-specific muted accent
physicalVisualSystem.typography: no generated text, seals, or fake calligraphy; deterministic copy may occupy the planned negative space

forbiddenElements: decorative point color without narrative purpose
qcAssertions: place and season are identifiable from concrete cues
near middle and far depth are distinct
the single accent serves the narrative beat
negative space is intentional rather than empty
dark ink and reflections fade before the subtitle-safe band
